summary.text: The story takes place on Otaria and follows Kamahl, who carries the Mirari into the Krosan Forest and becomes a druid of Krosa, and his sister Jeska, whom Cabal healing magic has transformed into Phage, a pit fighter whose touch brings death.
Heartbroken after Phage kills Nivea in the pits, Ixidor discovers his reality-sculpting powers, builds the kingdom of Topos and creates the angel Akroma to avenge her.

In the Nightmare War the Cabal and Kamahl's Krosans move against Akroma and Topos until Phage's slain souls become deathwurms, and Jeska absorbs them back into herself, even though it means becoming Phage again.
